entry.name: snowfall~
entry.description: The snowfall~ object controls a multi-dimensional particle as one or more audio ramps whose lifetime is triggered and controlled by an input phasor ramp from 0 to 1. The object will typically be used within a larger system of quasi-independent particles using the MC Wrapper as mc.snowfall~.

arguments.name: dimenions
arguments.description: Sets the number of dimensions (1 - 4) which determines the number of signal outputs. The default value is 1.

attributes.name: boundarymode
attributes.digest: Boundary Mode
attributes.description: Theattribute controls what happens when the particle output value reaches the currentor. It is global for all dimensions.

choices.label: Causes the particle to reverse its current direction.
Causes the particle to cease outputting; the signal output will become zero.

Causes the particle to move to the opposite boundary. If the particle reaches the current maximum value, its value jumps to the minimum. If the particle reaches the current minimum value, its value jumps to the maximum.
The particle's value remains at the value of the boundary (maximum or minimum).

attributes.name: dimensions
attributes.digest: Dimensions
attributes.description: Sets the number of dimensions (1 - 4) which determines the number of signal outputs. The default value is 1. Theattribute cannot be changed after the object is created. It can be set via an argument or typed-in attribute.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.digest: Direction / Velocity
attributes.description: contains up to four values, one for each dimension.When a particle starts, theattribute determines the velocity of movement. The value is expressed in units per second. For example, whenis set to 5 means, the output value will increase by 5 over one second. If theattribute is negative, the output value is likely to decrease over time. If theattribute is positive, the output value is likely to increase over time.

attributes.name: directiondev
attributes.digest: Direction Deviation
attributes.description: contains up to four values, one for each dimension.Sets a random deviation around the value ofused in setting the particle velocity and direction.

attributes.name: endmode
attributes.digest: End Mode
attributes.description: Sets the behavior when the particle ends, either as a result of hitting a max or min boundary or when the input signal resets or goes to zero.

choices.label: Whenis set to End Value, the output is set to the current value of theattribute when the particle ends.
Whenis set to Current Value, the output remains at its current value when the particle ends.

attributes.name: endvalue
attributes.digest: End Output Value
attributes.description: contains up to four values, one for each dimension.Sets the value to output when a particle's life ends.

attributes.name: energyramp
attributes.digest: Energy Ramp Factor
attributes.description: contains up to four values, one for each dimension.Themultiplies the incoming 0 - 1 ramp signal value as part of the particle calculation. If you do not want the particle to move faster as the input ramp value increases, set theto zero.
